# AIPLA

::: {.hero-subtitle}
AI in Physics Learning and Assessment
:::

::: {.lead}
A three-year research programme investigating how generative AI can be meaningfully integrated into upper-secondary physics education in Denmark. This site collects the working plan for the four-month technical-infrastructure contract within it.
:::

:::
:::

::: {.container .content-section}

## Pages

- **[About](about.qmd)** — project context, the ADDIE method, the four research questions, intended outputs
- **[Strands](strands.qmd)** — the three work strands (pedagogical bots, simulation/games, scoping investigation) and how they map to the timeline
- **[Examples](examples.qmd)** — real artefacts a project teacher made with GenAI before AIPLA existed: a live interactive projectile sim, a Socratic system prompt, and AI-misconception illustrations
- **[Timeline](timeline.qmd)** — 17-week plan, the three overlapping tracks, the handover fan-out, ownership map
- **[Architecture](architecture.qmd)** — ADRs for Strand A: cloud provider, region, model, RAG store, routing layer, multimodal, student auth, AILANG disclosure
- **[Evaluation](evaluation.qmd)** — capability-floor framework: task taxonomy, model panel, KPIs that drive routing and the local-deployment migration timeline
- **[Self-hosting](self-hosting.qmd)** — UCPH migration table: cloud components and their on-premises equivalents

People referenced by initials throughout (M, JB, AR, DS, ZL, P2, K) for light anonymisation — the team knows the mapping.

## Design principles

::: {.principle-grid}

::: {.principle-card}
### GDPR by design
EU-hosted infrastructure. No PII leakage to US providers where avoidable. Solutions hold up to UCPH data-protection review and to teachers' and parents' scrutiny.
:::

::: {.principle-card}
### Model-agnostic routing
Production chooses models per task class based on continuous capability-floor evaluation. Cloud APIs and local models are interchangeable through configuration.
:::

::: {.principle-card}
### Migration-ready
Every cloud component has a documented on-premises equivalent. Hosting can move to the University of Copenhagen's own infrastructure when capability and policy align.
:::

::: {.principle-card}
### Handover as a first-class deliverable
Documentation, pairing, and ADR sign-offs from week 4, not week 13. Each major artefact has a named co-owner who will operate it after the contract.
:::

:::

## Status

**Week 4 of build phase.** Three student-facing physics skills live: Boldkast (projectile motion, Danish stx), LED Planck (Planck's constant, Danish stx), KineBot (kinematics, NCERT/CBSE). Teacher UI wired to real backend; chat logs in BigQuery. 3 June check-in with teachers confirmed direction and added v1.1 priorities: teacher activity creation and branching, student image/document upload, proactive sim-reactive tutor, student consent prompt for logging, and researcher access tier. Mid-point review: 2026-06-26. Teacher pilots begin mid-August.

:::
